tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List the user's recent YADL projects (id, name, type, template).

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a labeling project. type is boxes, polygons, or keypoints. For keypoints, pass template hand|pose|face (default hand). Does not upload media — returns studio_url; a human adds files in the product UI.

tools.name: open_project
tools.description: Open a project studio by id or exact name.
